summary: Native OMP extension messages and administrative records (model_usage, session_init, ttsr_injection) are typed omp_event status/text blocks with bounded content and details, tool-result failures carry error status, and a timeline entry too large to send is cut visibly instead of failing its page.

replay.detail: Views are derived on read from the native transcript, and older records render with the new views the next time they are read. No claim replay or projection rebuild is added.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers or migrations change. The client-v0 schema gains one additive view type, so the generated contract digest changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or fleet coordination requirements change.

compatibility.detail: Additive client-v0 view omp_event (open view.type). Older clients ignore it and keep the block's text, which still carries the native record. Administrative OMP records that were previously only a raw fallback are now visible status blocks. A lone timeline entry above the response ceiling now arrives as an error entry (timeline-entry-too-large) in its place instead of failing the page.

downtime.detail: No restart or migration wait is added.

manual.detail: No manual action or configuration change is required.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to the previous binary is supported; no stored state changes.
